content.title: CEB Improves Model Robustness
content.TL;DR: Training your model with the Conditional Entropy Bottleneck is easy and makes your model more robust.
content.abstract: We  demonstrate  that  the  Conditional  Entropy  Bottleneck  (CEB)  can  improve model robustness.  CEB is an easy strategy to implement and works in tandem with data augmentation procedures. We report results of a large scale adversarial robustness study on CIFAR-10, as well as the IMAGENET-C Common Corruptions Benchmark.
